source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The guide uses context for the Axe scan and container for DOM observation. The actual content helper requires a selector container, while the window helper accepts an element or selector. When context is absent the explicit container becomes the scan context; the default observed node differs between content and chrome windows. These static contracts do not show an Axe engine or accessibility test passed.
title: The Axe guide separates the scan context from the watched container
